rules: :root { --plum: #5c3d6e; --lavender: #c3b2d7; --lilac: #e8dff5; --cream: #fdf8f2; --blush: #f5d9e8; --gold: #c9a85c; --dark: #1e1218; --text: #3a2840; --mid: #7a5d8a; }
* { margin: 0px; padding: 0px; box-sizing: border-box; }
html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }
body { font-family: "DM Sans", sans-serif; background: var(--cream); color: var(--text); overflow-x: hidden; }

nav { position: fixed; top: 0px; left: 0px; right: 0px; z-index: 200; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 0px 5vw; height: 70px; background: rgba(253, 248, 242, 0.97); backdrop-filter: blur(14px); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(195, 178, 215, 0.35); transition: background 0.3s, border-color 0.3s; }
nav.dark-nav { background: rgba(10, 10, 26, 0.97); border-bottom-color: rgba(195, 178, 215, 0.12); }
.nav-logo { font-family: "Playfair Display", serif; font-size: 1.3rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--plum); text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.3s; }
nav.dark-nav .nav-logo { color: white; }
.nav-logo span { color: var(--gold); font-style: italic; }
.nav-links { display: flex; gap: 2rem; list-style: none; }

.nav-links a { text-decoration: none; font-size: 0.82rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--text); letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: color 0.2s; position: relative; cursor: pointer; }
nav.dark-nav .nav-links a { color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65); }
.nav-links a::after { content: ""; position: absolute; bottom: -3px; left: 0px; width: 0px; height: 1.5px; background: var(--plum); transition: width 0.3s; }
nav.dark-nav .nav-links a::after { background: var(--gold); }
.nav-links a:hover, .nav-links a.active { color: var(--plum); }
nav.dark-nav .nav-links a:hover, nav.dark-nav .nav-links a.active { color: white; }
.nav-links a:hover::after, .nav-links a.active::after { width: 100%; }

.nav-cart { position: relative; cursor: pointer; font-size: 1.25rem; color: var(--plum); background: none; border-width: medium; border-style: none; border-color: currentcolor; border-image: none; font-family: inherit; }
nav.dark-nav .nav-cart { color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7); }

.cart-badge { position: absolute; top: -6px; right: -8px; background: var(--gold); color: white; font-size: 0.58rem; font-weight: 700; width: 16px; height: 16px; border-radius: 50%; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; }
.page { display: none; min-height: 100vh; }
.page.active { display: block; }
#page-customizer.active { display: flex; flex-direction: column; }

.btn-primary { display: inline-block; background: var(--plum); color: white; padding: 14px 32px; border-radius: 100px; font-size: 0.82rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; transition: background 0.2s, transform 0.15s, box-shadow 0.2s; box-shadow: rgba(92, 61, 110, 0.3) 0px 4px 20px; border-width: medium; border-style: none; border-color: currentcolor; border-image: none; cursor: pointer; font-family: "DM Sans", sans-serif; }
.btn-primary:hover { background: var(--dark); transform: translateY(-2px); }

.btn-outline { display: inline-block; border: 1.5px solid var(--plum); color: var(--plum); padding: 13px 28px; border-radius: 100px; font-size: 0.82rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; transition: background 0.2s, color 0.2s, transform 0.15s; cursor: pointer; background: transparent; font-family: "DM Sans", sans-serif; }
.btn-outline:hover { background: var(--plum); color: white; transform: translateY(-2px); }
.section-label { font-size: 0.7rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.18em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--gold); margin-bottom: 0.8rem; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; }
.section-label::after { content: ""; flex: 1 1 0%; height: 1px; background: linear-gradient(to right,var(--gold),transparent); max-width: 60px; }
.section-title { font-family: "Playfair Display", serif; font-size: clamp(1.8rem, 3.5vw, 2.6rem); color: var(--plum); line-height: 1.2; margin-bottom: 1rem; }
.fade-up { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(28px); transition: opacity 0.7s, transform 0.7s; }
.fade-up.visible { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0px); }
.breadcrumb { font-size: 0.75rem; color: var(--mid); margin-bottom: 1rem; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; }
.breadcrumb a { color: var(--mid); text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; }
.breadcrumb a:hover { color: var(--plum); }
.pkg-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 2rem; margin-bottom: 2rem; }

.pkg-card { background: white; border-radius: 24px; padding: 28px 24px; box-shadow: rgba(92, 61, 110, 0.1) 0px 4px 30px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; position: relative; }
.pkg-mini { background: linear-gradient(145deg, rgb(248, 238, 246), rgb(240, 224, 245)); }
.pkg-sweet { background: linear-gradient(145deg, rgb(232, 224, 248), rgb(221, 208, 245)); }
.pkg-golden { background: linear-gradient(145deg, rgb(248, 244, 224), rgb(245, 237, 187)); }
.pkg-badge { color: white; font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.1em; padding: 8px 22px; border-radius: 100px; margin-bottom: 1.2rem; align-self: center; }
.pkg-price-tag { font-size: 0.7rem; color: var(--mid); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.1em; margin-bottom: 4px; }
.pkg-price { font-family: "Playfair Display", serif; font-size: 2.4rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--dark); margin-bottom: 1.2rem; line-height: 1; }

.pkg-order-btn { width: 100%; padding: 13px; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.1em; cursor: pointer; border-width: medium; border-style: none; border-color: currentcolor; border-image: none; margin-bottom: 1.4rem; transition: opacity 0.2s, transform 0.15s; }
.pkg-order-btn:hover { opacity: 0.88; transform: translateY(-2px); }
.pkg-btn-plum { background: var(--plum); color: white; }
.pkg-btn-sweet { background: rgb(74, 53, 112); color: white; }
.pkg-btn-gold { background: var(--gold); color: white; }
.pkg-items { list-style: none; padding: 0px; width: 100%; }
.pkg-items li { font-size: 0.85rem; color: var(--text); padding: 7px 0px; border-bottom: 1px dashed rgba(92, 61, 110, 0.15); display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
.pkg-items li::before { content: "•"; color: var(--plum); font-weight: 700; }
.checkout-wrap { max-width: 1080px; margin: 0px auto; padding: 100px 5vw 60px; }
.checkout-title { font-family: "Playfair Display", serif; font-size: clamp(2rem, 4vw, 2.8rem); color: var(--plum); font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 2rem; }
.checkout-layout { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1.4fr; gap: 2.4rem; align-items: start; }
.checkout-summary-box { background: white; border-radius: 20px; padding: 24px; box-shadow: rgba(92, 61, 110, 0.1) 0px 4px 24px; position: sticky; top: 90px; }
.checkout-form-box { background: var(--cream); border-radius: 20px; padding: 28px; border: 1px solid rgba(195, 178, 215, 0.35); }

.checkout-section-head { font-family: "Playfair Display", serif; color: var(--plum); font-size: 1.1rem; margin-bottom: 1rem; padding-bottom: 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(195, 178, 215, 0.35); }
.checkout-order-list { margin-bottom: 1rem; }
.checkout-order-item { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: flex-start; padding: 8px 0px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(195, 178, 215, 0.2); font-size: 0.83rem; gap: 8px; }
.checkout-order-item-name { color: var(--text); flex: 1 1 0%; }
.checkout-order-item-price { color: var(--gold); font-weight: 700; white-space: nowrap; }
.checkout-total-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; font-size: 0.88rem; color: var(--mid); padding: 6px 0px; }
.checkout-grand { font-family: "Playfair Display", serif; font-size: 1.1rem; color: var(--plum); font-weight: 700; border-top: 2px solid var(--plum); padding-top: 10px; margin-top: 6px; }
.co-field-group { margin-bottom: 1.4rem; }
.co-label { display: block; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--mid); letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; margin-bottom: 8px; }

.co-input { width: 100%; border: 1.5px solid rgba(195, 178, 215, 0.5); border-radius: 10px; padding: 12px 14px; font-size: 0.9rem; font-family: "DM Sans", sans-serif; color: var(--text); background: white; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.2s; }
.co-input:focus { border-color: var(--plum); }
.co-textarea { min-height: 80px; resize: vertical; }
.co-option-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 10px; }

.co-option { background: white; border: 2px solid rgba(195, 178, 215, 0.4); border-radius: 12px; padding: 12px 8px; text-align: center; cursor: pointer; font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--mid); transition: 0.2s; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 4px; }
.co-option:hover { border-color: var(--plum); color: var(--plum); }
.co-option.selected { border-color: var(--plum); background: var(--lilac); color: var(--plum); }
.co-option-icon { font-size: 1.3rem; }
.co-datetime-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 10px; }

.co-datetime-btn { background: white; border: 2px solid rgba(195, 178, 215, 0.4); border-radius: 12px; padding: 12px 14px; cursor: pointer; font-size: 0.85rem; color: var(--mid); display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; transition: border-color 0.2s; }
.co-datetime-btn:hover { border-color: var(--plum); }
.co-submit-btn { width: 100%; text-align: center; margin-bottom: 10px; }
.co-back-btn { width: 100%; text-align: center; }
.invoice-wrap { max-width: 760px; margin: 0px auto; padding: 100px 5vw 60px; }
.invoice-card { background: white; border-radius: 20px; overflow: hidden; box-shadow: rgba(92, 61, 110, 0.15) 0px 8px 40px; }
.inv-header { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; padding: 28px 32px 20px; background: white; border-bottom: 2px solid var(--lavender); }
.inv-logo-area { position: relative; width: 160px; height: 80px; }
.inv-bubbles { position: absolute; inset: 0px; }
.inv-bubble { position: absolute; border-radius: 50%; opacity: 0.6; }
.inv-bubble-lg { width: 70px; height: 70px; }
.inv-bubble-md { width: 40px; height: 40px; }
.inv-bubble-sm { width: 24px; height: 24px; }
.inv-brand-sig { position: absolute; bottom: 0px; left: 0px; font-family: "Playfair Display", serif; font-size: 0.78rem; color: var(--plum); font-style: italic; z-index: 2; }
.inv-title-area { text-align: right; }
.inv-word { font-family: "Playfair Display", serif; font-size: 2.6rem; color: var(--plum); font-style: italic; letter-spacing: 0.03em; }
.inv-meta { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; padding: 20px 32px; background: rgb(250, 247, 255); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--lavender); }
.inv-meta-label { font-size: 0.7rem; color: var(--mid); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.1em; margin-bottom: 4px; }
.inv-meta-val { font-family: "Playfair Display", serif; font-size: 1rem; color: var(--plum); font-weight: 700; }
.inv-meta-val.gold { color: var(--gold); }
.inv-meta-sub { font-size: 0.78rem; color: var(--mid); }
.inv-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; }
.inv-table th { background: var(--lavender); color: var(--plum); font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 10px 14px; text-align: left; }
.inv-th-desc { width: 50%; }
.inv-table td { padding: 9px 14px; font-size: 0.82rem; color: var(--text); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(195, 178, 215, 0.2); }
.inv-table tbody tr:nth-child(2n) td { background: rgb(253, 250, 255); }
.inv-subtotal-row td { font-size: 0.85rem; color: var(--plum); background: var(--lilac) !important; }
.inv-payment-section { padding: 14px 32px; background: rgb(255, 255, 255); }
.inv-payment-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; padding: 5px 0px; font-size: 0.85rem; }
.inv-payment-label { color: var(--text); }
.inv-payment-val.plum { color: var(--plum); font-weight: 700; }
.inv-payment-val.gold { color: var(--gold); font-weight: 700; }
.inv-bottom-row { background: var(--lavender); }

.inv-delivery-info { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 10px 24px; font-size: 0.8rem; letter-spacing: 0.06em; color: var(--plum); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(195, 178, 215, 0.4); }
.inv-chk { font-size: 1rem; color: var(--plum); }

.inv-grand-total-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; padding: 12px 24px; font-family: "Playfair Display", serif; font-size: 1.05rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--plum); }
.inv-footer { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; padding: 18px 32px; background: white; border-top: 2px solid var(--lavender); }
.inv-follow { background: var(--gold); color: white; font-size: 0.78rem; padding: 10px 18px; border-radius: 100px; text-align: center; min-width: 120px; }
.inv-thankyou { font-family: "Playfair Display", serif; font-size: 2rem; color: var(--plum); font-style: italic; }
.inv-actions { display: flex; gap: 12px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-top: 1.8rem; }
.inv-actions .btn-primary, .inv-actions .btn-outline { flex: 1 1 0%; text-align: center; min-width: 180px; }
footer { background: var(--dark); color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5); padding: 60px 7vw 30px; }
.footer-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 2fr 1fr 1fr 1fr; gap: 3rem; margin-bottom: 3rem; }
.footer-logo { font-family: "Playfair Display", serif; font-size: 1.4rem; font-weight: 700; color: white; margin-bottom: 1rem; cursor: pointer; }
.footer-logo span { color: var(--gold); font-style: italic; }
.footer-desc { font-size: 0.83rem; line-height: 1.7; margin-bottom: 1.4rem; }
.footer-social { display: flex; gap: 0.6rem; }

.social-btn { width: 34px; height: 34px; border-radius: 50%; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 0.82rem; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s, border-color 0.2s; color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.55); text-decoration: none; }
.social-btn:hover { background: var(--plum); border-color: var(--plum); color: white; }
.footer-col h4 { color: white; font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; margin-bottom: 1.1rem; }
.footer-col ul { list-style: none; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.6rem; }
.footer-col a { color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.45); text-decoration: none; font-size: 0.82rem; transition: color 0.2s; cursor: pointer; }
.footer-col a:hover { color: var(--lavender); }

.footer-bottom { border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08); padding-top: 1.4rem; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 1rem; font-size: 0.75rem; }
.footer-mini { background: var(--dark); color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.4); padding: 30px 7vw 20px; border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.07); }
.footer-mini .footer-bottom { border-width: medium; border-style: none; border-color: currentcolor; border-image: none; padding-top: 0px; }
.shop-carousel { position: relative; width: 100%; height: 360px; overflow: hidden; margin-top: 70px; }
.carousel-track { display: flex; height: 100%; transition: transform 0.55s cubic-bezier(0.77, 0, 0.175, 1); }
.carousel-slide { flex: 0 0 100%; height: 100%; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 0px 7vw; position: relative; overflow: hidden; }
.carousel-slide::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0px; background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45); }
.carousel-content { position: relative; z-index: 2; max-width: 520px; }

.carousel-tag { display: inline-block; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22); backdrop-filter: blur(8px); color: white; font-size: 0.7rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 5px 14px; border-radius: 100px; margin-bottom: 1rem; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3); }
.carousel-title { font-family: "Playfair Display", serif; font-size: clamp(2rem, 4vw, 3rem); color: white; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.1; margin-bottom: 0.7rem; }
.carousel-sub { font-size: 0.88rem; color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.82); line-height: 1.7; margin-bottom: 1.2rem; max-width: 400px; }
.carousel-price { font-family: "Playfair Display", serif; font-size: 1.4rem; color: rgb(255, 216, 117); font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 1.4rem; }

.carousel-btn { background: white; color: var(--plum); border-width: medium; border-style: none; border-color: currentcolor; border-image: none; padding: 12px 28px; border-radius: 100px; font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: 0.2s; font-family: "DM Sans", sans-serif; }
.carousel-btn:hover { background: var(--gold); color: white; transform: translateY(-2px); }
.carousel-visual { position: relative; z-index: 2; font-size: 9rem; filter: drop-shadow(rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 20px 40px); animation: 4s ease-in-out 0s infinite normal none running bob; }

.carousel-arrow { position: absolute; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); z-index: 10; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18); backdrop-filter: blur(8px); border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3); color: white; font-size: 1.8rem; width: 46px; height: 46px; border-radius: 50%; cursor: pointer; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; transition: background 0.2s; }
.carousel-arrow:hover { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.35); }
.carousel-prev { left: 2vw; }
.carousel-next { right: 2vw; }
.carousel-dots { position: absolute; bottom: 18px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); display: flex; gap: 8px; z-index: 10; }

.c-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.4); cursor: pointer; transition: 0.3s; border-width: medium; border-style: none; border-color: currentcolor; border-image: none; }
.c-dot.active { background: white; width: 24px; border-radius: 4px; }
.cart-overlay { position: fixed; inset: 0px; background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5); z-index: 500; opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; transition: opacity 0.35s; backdrop-filter: blur(3px); }
.cart-overlay.open { opacity: 1; pointer-events: all; }

.cart-drawer { position: fixed; top: 0px; right: 0px; width: min(420px, 100vw); height: 100vh; background: var(--cream); z-index: 501; transform: translateX(100%); transition: transform 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.77, 0, 0.175, 1); display: flex; flex-direction: column; box-shadow: rgba(92, 61, 110, 0.18) -8px 0px 40px; }
.cart-drawer.open { transform: translateX(0px); }
.cart-drawer-header { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 22px 24px 18px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(195, 178, 215, 0.35); flex-shrink: 0; }
.cart-drawer-title { font-family: "Playfair Display", serif; font-size: 1.4rem; color: var(--plum); }

.cart-close-btn { background: none; border: 1px solid rgba(195, 178, 215, 0.5); color: var(--mid); width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: 50%; cursor: pointer; font-size: 1rem; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; transition: 0.2s; }
.cart-close-btn:hover { background: var(--plum); color: white; border-color: var(--plum); }
.cart-items-list { flex: 1 1 0%; overflow-y: auto; padding: 16px 24px; }
.cart-empty { text-align: center; padding: 60px 20px; color: var(--mid); }
.cart-empty-icon { font-size: 4rem; margin-bottom: 1rem; display: block; }
.cart-empty p { font-size: 0.9rem; line-height: 1.6; }
.cart-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; padding: 14px 0px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(195, 178, 215, 0.25); }
.cart-item-emoji { font-size: 2.2rem; width: 52px; height: 52px; background: var(--lilac); border-radius: 14px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-shrink: 0; }
.cart-item-info { flex: 1 1 0%; min-width: 0px; }
.cart-item-name { font-family: "Playfair Display", serif; font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--plum); white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
.cart-item-sub { font-size: 0.74rem; color: var(--mid); margin-top: 2px; }
.cart-item-price { font-weight: 700; color: var(--gold); font-size: 0.9rem; }
.cart-qty-ctrl { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin-top: 8px; }

.qty-btn { width: 26px; height: 26px; border-radius: 50%; border: 1px solid rgba(195, 178, 215, 0.5); background: white; cursor: pointer; font-size: 1rem; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; color: var(--plum); font-weight: 700; transition: 0.15s; }
.qty-btn:hover { background: var(--plum); color: white; border-color: var(--plum); }
.qty-num { font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.88rem; color: var(--plum); min-width: 20px; text-align: center; }

.cart-item-remove { background: none; border-width: medium; border-style: none; border-color: currentcolor; border-image: none; cursor: pointer; color: rgba(122, 93, 138, 0.4); font-size: 1rem; padding: 4px; transition: color 0.2s; }
.cart-item-remove:hover { color: rgb(238, 0, 85); }
.cart-drawer-footer { padding: 18px 24px 28px; border-top: 1px solid rgba(195, 178, 215, 0.35); flex-shrink: 0; }
.cart-subtotal { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.05rem; color: var(--plum); margin-bottom: 10px; }
.cart-note { font-size: 0.72rem; color: var(--mid); margin-bottom: 14px; line-height: 1.5; }

.size-select { font-size: 0.72rem; border: 1px solid rgba(195, 178, 215, 0.5); border-radius: 8px; padding: 4px 8px; color: var(--plum); background: white; cursor: pointer; font-family: "DM Sans", sans-serif; margin-top: 4px; }

.toast { position: fixed; bottom: 30px; right: 30px; background: var(--plum); color: white; padding: 12px 22px; border-radius: 100px; font-size: 0.84rem; font-weight: 600; z-index: 999; transform: translateY(80px); opacity: 0; transition: transform 0.4s, opacity 0.4s; box-shadow: rgba(92, 61, 110, 0.4) 0px 8px 24px; }
.toast.show { transform: translateY(0px); opacity: 1; }
.hero { min-height: 100vh; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; padding-top: 70px; }
.hero-left { display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; padding: 6vw 5vw 6vw 7vw; position: relative; }

.dt-cal-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(7, 1fr); gap: 3px; }
.dt-cal-day-name { font-size: 0.65rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--mid); text-align: center; padding: 4px 0px; letter-spacing: 0.04em; }

.dt-cal-day { font-size: 0.78rem; text-align: center; padding: 7px 4px; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; color: var(--text); transition: background 0.15s, color 0.15s; border-width: medium; border-style: none; border-color: currentcolor; border-image: none; background: none; font-family: "DM Sans", sans-serif; font-weight: 500; }
.dt-cal-day:hover:not(.empty):not(.past) { background: var(--lilac); color: var(--plum); }
.dt-cal-day.empty { cursor: default; }
.dt-cal-day.past { color: rgba(122, 93, 138, 0.3); cursor: not-allowed; }
.dt-cal-day.today { font-weight: 800; color: var(--plum); }
.dt-cal-day.selected { font-weight: 700; background: var(--plum) !important; color: white !important; }
.dt-cal-day.sunday, .dt-cal-day.saturday { color: rgb(192, 57, 43); }
.dt-cal-day.sunday.past, .dt-cal-day.saturday.past { color: rgba(192, 57, 43, 0.3); }
.dt-cal-legend { display: flex; gap: 12px; margin-top: 10px; font-size: 0.7rem; }
.dt-legend-dot { width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 50%; display: inline-block; margin-right: 4px; }
.dt-legend-avail { background: rgb(39, 174, 96); }
.dt-legend-full { background: rgb(231, 76, 60); }
.dt-slots-title { font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--mid); margin-bottom: 10px; }
.dt-slots-list { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; max-height: 300px; overflow-y: auto; }

.dt-slot { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 10px 14px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1.5px solid rgba(195, 178, 215, 0.35); cursor: pointer; transition: 0.15s; }
.dt-slot:hover:not(.full) { border-color: var(--plum); background: var(--lilac); }
.dt-slot.selected { border-color: var(--plum); background: var(--plum); }
.dt-slot.selected .dt-slot-time { color: white; }
.dt-slot.full { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: 0.85; }
.dt-slot-left { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; }
.dt-slot-radio { width: 14px; height: 14px; border-radius: 50%; border: 2px solid rgba(195, 178, 215, 0.6); flex-shrink: 0; transition: 0.15s; }
.dt-slot.selected .dt-slot-radio { border-color: white; background: white; }
.dt-slot-time { font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text); }
.dt-slot-status { font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; padding: 3px 10px; border-radius: 100px; }
.dt-slot-status.avail { color: rgb(39, 174, 96); background: rgba(39, 174, 96, 0.1); }
.dt-slot-status.full { color: rgb(231, 76, 60); background: rgba(231, 76, 60, 0.1); }
.dt-modal-footer { display: flex; gap: 12px; margin-top: 24px; justify-content: center; }

.dt-btn-cancel { background: rgb(232, 224, 238); color: var(--mid); border-width: medium; border-style: none; border-color: currentcolor; border-image: none; padding: 13px 32px; border-radius: 100px; font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; font-family: "DM Sans", sans-serif; transition: background 0.15s; }
.dt-btn-cancel:hover { background: rgb(216, 206, 232); }

.dt-btn-confirm { background: var(--plum); color: white; border-width: medium; border-style: none; border-color: currentcolor; border-image: none; padding: 13px 36px; border-radius: 100px; font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; font-family: "DM Sans", sans-serif; box-shadow: rgba(92, 61, 110, 0.3) 0px 4px 16px; transition: background 0.15s, transform 0.15s; }
.dt-btn-confirm:hover { background: var(--dark); transform: translateY(-1px); }
.dt-btn-confirm:disabled { background: var(--lavender); cursor: not-allowed; transform: none; box-shadow: none; }
